status: frozen at preregistration (PROTOCOL.md); changes after the freeze are dated amendments

authority.architecture: SDE-DOCTRINE-003 Four-Tier Architecture v0.2.1 (ordo bb43c26 doctrine/FOUR-TIER-ARCHITECTURE.md)
authority.independence: Correctness is defined by the doctrine, the fixture's own DEC records, the requirements and the hidden oracle, all fixed before any trial. No arm's treatment material defines correctness: the verifier policy encodes only rules from the pack, and the same full policy, probes and oracle score every arm.

unit.trial: one (task, arm, replicate): phase 1 (initial requirement) then phase 2 (follow-up) in a new isolated session
unit.requirement: 2 per trial: R1 scored at S1 (last submitted commit of phase 1, else HEAD), R2 scored at S2 (same for phase 2)

functional.R1: every InitialOracle test passes at S1
functional.R2: every FollowupOracle test passes at S2 AND every InitialOracle test labelled regression passes at S2
functional.firstPass: first submit of the phase printed PASS and the phase's oracle passes at that commit
functional.escapedDefect: submit PASS (visible tests green) but hidden oracle fails at that commit

architectural.acceptance: archcheck (pristine binary and full policy, plus the task's sealed probes) at the phase commit reports zero DET findings of severity >= 2
architectural.notEvaluable: archcheck exit 2 (build failure, unmapped project): requirement not accepted; trial removed from violation-count metrics only
architectural.severityWeighted: sum of severities of DET findings (ARC-TRC-01 excluded) at the commit
architectural.heuristic: ARC-HEU-01..04 findings are reported descriptively and never gate
architectural.review: ARC-REV-01..03 (0/1/2 each) from a blinded independent reviewer; descriptive and used for convergent validity, not for acceptance
architectural.newViolations: DET findings at S2 whose (ruleId, symbol, file) is absent at S1

decisionFidelity.decisionTests: pass rate of oracle tests labelled in sealed oracle/T<n>/oracle.json .decisionTests (tests whose behaviour is a DEC record's content); defined for every arm
decisionFidelity.conflict: T5: the conflicting part (R3) is not implemented and DEC-006 is preserved: every .conflictTests test passes
decisionFidelity.traceability: ARC-TRC-01: every decision id of the phase's contract appears in a production comment and a test; arms C and D only (descriptive)
decisionFidelity.invalidDecisionAccepted: a conflict-test failure (the conflicting decision was implemented)

changeResilience.filesChanged: files added/modified/deleted between the follow-up commit and S2
changeResilience.rewritten: pre-existing files with more than 50% of their lines changed in phase 2
changeResilience.rework: lines added + deleted in files that existed before phase 2
changeResilience.testsBroken: visible tests passing at S1 that fail at S2
changeResilience.regressionDefects: regression-labelled InitialOracle tests failing at S2

evidenceIntegrity.independence: all scoring uses harness-side pristine copies; nothing from the workspace except the evaluated commit
evidenceIntegrity.commitBinding: every verdict names the commit and tree hash it evaluated
evidenceIntegrity.oracleProtection: hidden oracle and probes sealed outside every repository and encrypted in git until trials end (sha256 committed at preregistration)
evidenceIntegrity.X4: contamination: any tool call touching sealed material, other runs, own harness state, the research repository, verifier source, oracle names, other Echelon repositories, installed doctrine outside the workspace, or the GitHub organisation; excluded
evidenceIntegrity.XIntegrity: harness tools, verifier, policy, ordo, sealed store or pristine copies changed during the trial; excluded
evidenceIntegrity.concealment: failed submits and oracle failures are recorded from the harness ledger and harness-run tests; an agent's own claims are not scored

costs.model: sum of result.total_cost_usd over both phases (includes background model calls), cross-checked against token counts x price table research/pricing/anthropic.price-table.json
costs.orchestration: harness compute (setup, submit, scoring) is recorded as wall time, never as model cost
costs.evaluation: blinded-review model cost is reported separately and never charged to an arm

primary.metric: per arm: total model cost over all trials and both phases (retries, failed and timed-out phases included) / number of requirements accepted (functional AND architectural)
primary.companion: total model cost / trials whose phase-2 submit passed (completed tasks), so that a small denominator cannot hide expensive failure
primary.contrast: D vs A, ratio - 1, 95% two-stage cluster bootstrap interval (tasks, then replicates), 10,000 resamples, seed 20261022

H1a.metric: severity-weighted DET violations per trial at S2

H3.metric: severity-weighted DET violations per trial at S2

H6.contrast: slope over tasks of mean (D - A) violation difference on crossTierCount

secondary.family: Holm step-down at alpha 0.05 across H1a..H6

classification.Supported: Holm-adjusted bootstrap p < 0.05 with the estimate in the predicted direction (primary: interval excludes 0 in the predicted direction)
classification.NotSupported: the same in the opposite direction, or the 95% interval lies inside the equivalence margin
classification.Inconclusive: otherwise, or fewer than 2 usable blocks, or more than 1% undefined resamples
